walkthroughs.body_html:
An Introduction to the Gospel of Luke / Mark — a core area of A-Level Religious Studies.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

An Introduction to the Gospel of Luke / Mark brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with An Introduction to the Gospel of Luke / Mark.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
